description: An index with an arithmetic key makes static traversal analysis an error
notes: The spec allows constant index operations in a static traversal without defining constant, and 1 + 1 has a constant value, though it is an operation. hashicorp/hcl only makes an index a traversal step when its key is a literal value or a string literal (parseExpressionTraversals in hclsyntax/parser.go); any other key gives an IndexExpr, which has no AsTraversal method.
reference_error: A single static variable reference is required
